input.plan:
# Fix job-title click not marking seen

## Why it broke

Opening a role is supposed to mark it seen: the title should pick up `.position-seen` and render in muted “visited” color ([`styles.css`](relocation_jobs/static/styles.css) around the `.position-card.position-seen .job-title` rules).

That used to happen in [`events.js`](relocation_jobs/static/js/events.js) via `markSeenFromPositionCard` on `.job-title` clicks. After jobs moved into the `<position-card>` web component, that path is dead:

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
  participant User
  participant Title as a.job-title
  participant Card as PositionCard._onClick
  participant Board as events.js #jobs click
  participant API as POST /api/jobs/seen

  User->>Title: click (opens listing)
  Title->>Card: click bubbles
  Note over Card: closest(".job-title") then stopPropagation and return
  Card--xBoard: never reaches markSeenFromPositionCard
  Note over Board: also bails with closest("position-card")
  Card--xAPI: never called
```

Two independent cuts:

1. [`PositionCard._onClick`](relocation_jobs/static/js/position-card.js) treats the title as a no-op:

```573:576:relocation_jobs/static/js/position-card.js
    if (t.closest(".job-title")) {
      e.stopPropagation();
      return;
    }
```

2. The board listener returns before the title handler for any click inside the custom element:

```639:640:relocation_jobs/static/js/events.js
  $("jobs").addEventListener("click", async (e) => {
    if (e.target.closest("position-card")) return;
```

The explicit **Seen before** button still works (`_toggleSeen` → `POST /api/jobs/seen` → `_apply`). The API and board patch path are fine; title-open never fires them.

## Fix

In [`relocation_jobs/static/js/position-card.js`](relocation_jobs/static/js/position-card.js):

- Add a silent `_markSeenOnOpen()` next to `_toggleSeen`: if `this._job.seen` is already true, return; otherwise POST `{ seen: true }` with country/company/url/idempotency_key, then `_apply(data)` (same as other card mutations so React board state updates via `position-state-changed` → `patchJobOnBoard`).
- Do **not** toast on title-open (matches original `markJobSeen`, which is silent).
- Do **not** `preventDefault` — the `<a class="job-title" target="_blank">` must still open the listing.
- Call `void this._markSeenOnOpen()` from the `.job-title` branch in `_onClick` instead of returning immediately.

Leave [`events.js`](relocation_jobs/static/js/events.js) as-is. The `position-card` early-return is still required so leftover board handlers do not double-fire applied/rejected/etc. The dead `.job-title` block is unreachable for current cards and is not the fix.

## Verify

- Click an unseen job title on the board: listing opens in a new tab, title goes muted, **Seen before** becomes active, and a reload still shows it seen.
- Click an already-seen title: no extra request / no flicker.
- **Seen before** toggle still marks and clears.
- Company workspace position card gets the same title-open behavior (it shares this component).

content.text:
Clicking a job title now marks that role as seen again.

The title click was being swallowed by `<position-card>`: `_onClick` stopped the event and returned, and the board listener never ran `markSeenFromPositionCard`. Opening a listing therefore never called `POST /api/jobs/seen`, so the card stayed unmarked.

The card now marks seen on title-open. If the role is already seen, it does nothing. The listing still opens in a new tab, and there is no toast (same as the old silent `markJobSeen` path).

Verified against a live card on the local panel: title click POSTs `{ seen: true }`, the card gets `.position-seen`, **Seen before** becomes active, a second title click does not POST again, and the explicit toggle still marks and clears. Cache-bust on the script tag was bumped so the browser loads the new module.
